item.title: A recent history of America First streamer Nick Fuentes’ Holocaust denial
item.description: Amid a wave of conservative infighting last year over his appearances on right-leaning online shows, white nationalist streamer Nick Fuentes remarked on his own program in December that he was “so sick” of being labeled a Holocaust denier. The very next day, during an interview with Piers Morgan, Fuentes mocked the question of how many Jewish people died in the Holocaust, saying: “I don’t know, I’m thinking maybe 7 million, what’s the number? Seven, 6 million? Something like that. Eight million?

item.title: Media Matters weekly newsletter, February 13
item.description: Welcome back to Media Matters’ weekly newsletter. This week: MAGA media sharpens its blade against Attorney General Pam Bondi. Fox figures once condemned presidential corruption — now they’re working for Donald Trump. Right-wing media are mouthpieces for Department of Homeland Security abuses. If you want this delivered straight to your inbox, subscribe here.

item.title: New study shows immigration has a positive impact on government budgets, countering right-wing media claims that immigrants drain the economy
item.description: An updated study from the Cato Institute conclusively demonstrated that immigrants to the United States, no matter their legal status or skill level, have had a positive effect on government budgets at the local, state, and federal levels over the past 30 years.
